headline: Week 1: Hot Cocks Out Early and Swinging
subhead: BigD dropped 168 with a 30-burger riding the pine and somehow that's the most on-brand sentence in league history.
matchOfTheWeek: Put an AR to My Head edging Bo Nix Celli 134-124 was the only matchup with a pulse all afternoon. Saquon went full glizzy mode for 33.2, Anthony Richardson actually completed passes for 27, and Celli still hung 124 in a loss — which somehow feels worse than getting blown out. Welcome to the season where you get out-QB'd by a guy whose roster is a coin flip every Sunday.
powerRankingsShakeup: Hot Cocks announce themselves as the early Week 1 darling while The Good Ladds eat 40 despite a 31-point Josh Allen — sending Mig straight into the 'maybe SuperFlex is hard actually' tier. LargestofRocks quietly looks scary, MassiveCocks quietly does not.
mainRecap:
Let's start at the top because BigD will not shut up about it for six months otherwise: Hot Cocks dropped 168.10 on The Good Ladds, the league's first 40-point beatdown of the year, and the truly unhinged part is Isaiah Likely put up a THIRTY POINT SPIKE on his bench. You scored 168 with your TE1 in street clothes. Mig, meanwhile, got a 31-burger from Josh Allen and still lost by 40 — that's not a loss, that's a war crime. Frame the Allen box score, burn the rest.

Over in the 'who left more points at home' category, Patrickreegs and The Olave Garden put on a clinic — 39.88 points on the bench, including a 24.4 from Jameson Williams. You started the wrong people in Week 1 of a dynasty league you've been prepping for since May. Therapy is cheaper than this hobby, Patrick.

Jets' Juniors quietly ran a 96.6% efficient lineup and stomped OnlyFants by 30, because Cubby decided to christen 2024 by being the lowest scorer in the entire league at 106.72. OnlyFants more like OnlyBenchwarmers. Mattwunder is going to spend the next 14 weeks pretending he's a tactical genius and not just the guy who beat the worst score of the week.

LargestofRocks went for 149 behind a Jayden Reed 33-spot AND a Jayden Daniels 28 AND ALSO had J.K. Dobbins drop 22.9 from the bench — at some point this is just bragging. MassiveCocks ate it.

226 Alpha rode a vintage Cooper Kupp 32 past Olave Garden, T Swift's Baddies survived Stroud Boys in a game where Lamar's 25 was basically the entire offense, and KyleDech reminded everyone that putting an AR to your head is occasionally a sound roster construction strategy. Occasionally.
